modules.title: Your course, your plan
modules.summary: Why UKVI must be satisfied you are a genuine student, and how to explain your choice of course, university and country honestly and clearly.

modules.title: Money and documents that meet the rules
modules.summary: The financial requirement for a Student visa, what evidence UKVI accepts, and how to plan fees for the whole course, not just year one.

modules.title: Honest applications
modules.summary: What counts as deception in a UK visa application, the long-term consequences, and how to protect yourself from agents who "improve" documents.

sessions.title: One-to-one mock credibility interview
sessions.detail: A 30-minute video call based on your own application, with feedback. Book it once you have passed Modules 1–3. Your study-plan statement from Module 1 is used to prepare.

modules.title: Your visa conditions
modules.summary: The conditions attached to your Student visa: work limits, study and attendance, reporting changes, your eVisa, and what happens if conditions are broken.

modules.title: Arrive and enrol
modules.summary: When you can travel, what Border Force may ask, how to enrol on time, and what to do if you are delayed.

modules.title: Managing money in the UK
modules.summary: Budgeting, renting legally, fee instalments, currency risk, and the scams and money-mule schemes that target new international students.

modules.title: Studying in the UK
modules.summary: How UK university teaching and assessment work, referencing and academic integrity, the rules on AI tools and essay mills, and how to get help early.

modules.title: Wellbeing, safety and settling in
modules.summary: Your right to NHS care, laws that protect you and laws that can catch you out, and where to get help when things go wrong.

sessions.title: Live pre-departure briefing
sessions.detail: A group webinar with our team and current students. Bring your questions from Modules 4–8. Recorded if you cannot attend.

sessions.title: Check-in 1, week 2: Settling in
sessions.detail: Enrolment, accommodation, bank account and GP. Have your Module 5 arrival plan and Module 8 support map ready.

sessions.title: Check-in 2, week 6: First assessments
sessions.detail: Attendance, first coursework and working hours. Have your Module 4 work plan and Module 7 study plan ready.

sessions.title: End-of-term review, weeks 11–12
sessions.detail: Results so far, plans for next term, and your year-two fee plan from Module 2 checked against exchange rates.

sessions.title: Peer circles (optional)
sessions.detail: Two 45-minute small-group sessions with students from similar backgrounds.
